**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2024/02/20 (Tue) 10:41
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] MK watches from Nezha's chariot as the fight turns, the celestial army begins to win and the monkeys start to run.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] MK frantically looks for Macaque and Wukong but can't see them in the chaos.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Nezha, piloting the chariot, tries to reassure MK, saying, "Don't worry, mortal. We'll find them."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] MK expresses his worry, saying, "I hope they're okay," with a shaking voice.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Macaque appears, covered in cuts and bruises, and jumps onto the chariot.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Macaque informs MK and Nezha that "Wukong got away," but he has "his necklace."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] MK recognizes the necklace as "the diamond snare" in disbelief.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Macaque confirms it is the only thing that can hold Wukong and insists they must keep it safe.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Nezha agrees, stating they will take it to the Jade Emperor, who will know what to do with it.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] MK looks at the necklace, wondering what will happen next.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Nezha lands his chariot next to MK to check on him, asking, "Are you alright, mortal?"
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] MK expresses gratitude, saying, "Thank you for saving me."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Nezha explains that it is their duty to protect the innocent.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] MK asks about the fate of the monkeys, and Nezha explains they will be brought to the Jade Emperor for judgment.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] MK feels guilty, saying he didn't mean for any of this to happen.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Nezha reassures MK that he did not cause the chaos, attributing it to the monkeys' greed and arrogance.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] MK inquires about Macaque and Wukong, expressing concern about not seeing them after the fight.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Nezha's expression darkens as he states that they are still at large but reassures MK they will not escape justice for long.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Nezha climbs back into his chariot and takes off into the sky, leaving MK feeling awe and gratitude.
